title: Hanford project minutes report 66 LAW containers shipped to IDF by May 2026
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Hanford Field Office
summary: May 2026 WTP project-managers meeting minutes report that 66 containers had been shipped to the Integrated Disposal Facility and that acceptable-quality LAW glass processing would continue. Denominator: Sixty-six containers reported shipped to IDF by the May 14, 2026 meeting, kept separate from filled, accepted, disposed, rejected, or remaining containers.
key_findings: Finding: May 2026 WTP project-managers meeting minutes report that 66 containers had been shipped to the Integrated Disposal Facility and that acceptable-quality LAW glass processing would continue.
